basic_details.job_title: CCS HAU Graduate Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: CCS Haryana Agricultural University (CCS HAU) has released the Graduate Trainee Recruitment 2026 notification under Notification No. ADSCP/2026/397-420. Eligible candidates with a B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture or M.Sc. Agriculture degree can apply by sending their updated resume to [email protected] from 14 October 2026 to 19 October 2026. Selected candidates will receive a CTC of Rs. 4.5 LPA. Candidates can check the eligibility criteria, stipend details, important dates, and official notification PDF below.

qualification.details: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture or M.Sc. (Agriculture) degree.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will receive a CTC of 4.5 LPA. The official notification does not state the duration of the training period.

selection_process: The official notification does not specify the selection process stages.
how_to_apply: Send your resume by email to [email protected].
Ensure the application is sent on or before 19.10.2026.
